```{r}
cols_a <- c("MRUN", "AÑO_PROCESO", "COD_SEXO", "FECHA_NACIMIENTO", "RBD", "CODIGO_REGION", "CODIGO_PROVINCIA", "RAMA_EDUCACIONAL", "GRUPO_DEPENDENCIA", "AÑO_EGRESO", "PROMEDIO_NOTAS", "PTJE_NEM", "PTJE_RANKING", "LYC_ACTUAL", "MATE_ACTUAL", "HYCS_ACTUAL", "CIENCIAS_ACTUAL", "BEA", "LYC_ANTERIOR", "MATE_ANTERIOR", "HYCS_ANTERIOR", "CIENCIAS_ANTERIOR")
a <- rbind(a04, a05, a06, a07, a08, a09, a10, a11)
a %<>% dplyr::select(cols_a)
colnames(a) <- tolower(colnames(a))
a %<>% dplyr::rename(
  sexo = cod_sexo, region_rbd = codigo_region, provincia_rbd = codigo_provincia,
  rama = rama_educacional, dependencia = grupo_dependencia, egreso_yyyy = año_egreso,
  lenguaje_actual = lyc_actual, matematica_actual = mate_actual, historia_actual = hycs_actual, ciencias_actual = ciencias_actual,
  lenguaje_anterior = lyc_anterior, matematica_anterior = mate_anterior, historia_anterior = hycs_anterior, ciencias_anterior = ciencias_anterior,
  nem = ptje_nem, ranking = ptje_ranking
)
a %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  dob_yyyy = fecha_nacimiento %% 10000,
  dob_mm = as.integer(str_sub(as.character(fecha_nacimiento), end = -5))
) %>%
  dplyr::select(-fecha_nacimiento)
a %<>% dplyr::rename(year = año_proceso)

b <- rbind(b04, b05, b06, b07, b08, b09, b10, b11)
b %<>% dplyr::select(MRUN, AÑO_PROCESO, INGRESO_BRUTO_FAM)
colnames(b) <- tolower(colnames(b))
b %<>% dplyr::rename(year = año_proceso, ingreso = ingreso_bruto_fam)

ab <- merge(a, b, by = c("mrun", "year"))

for (col in setdiff(var_names_ip, colnames(ab))) {
  ab[, col] <- NA
}

c <- rbind(c04, c05, c06, c07, c08, c09, c10, c11)
c %<>% dplyr::select(-c("TIPO_IDENTIFICACION", "NOMBRE_CARRERA", "SEDE_CARRERA", "SIGLA_UNIVERSIDAD", "LUGAR", "BEA"))
colnames(c) <- tolower(colnames(c))
c %<>% dplyr::rename(year = año_proceso, marca = estado_preferencia, puntpond = pond_año_acad)
c_w <- c %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = preferencia,
    values_from = c(codigo_carrera, marca, puntaje, puntpond),
    names_prefix = ""
  )

for (col in setdiff(c(var_names_bea, var_names_pace, var_names_mat, var_names_rm), colnames(c_w))) {
  c_w[, col] <- NA
}
```

```{r}
abc <- merge(ab, c_w, by = c("mrun", "year"), all.x = TRUE)
saveRDS(abc, "data/data_students_2004_2011.rds")
```

Add program of enrollment in that year

Fix students with multiple enrollment in a given year
- Use highest preference among reported preferences in that admissions process
- If still issue, use program they remain enrolled later

```{r}
e_single <- e %>%
  dplyr::rename(year = YEAR) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mrun) & !is.na(codigo_demre) & codigo_demre > 0 & nivel_global == "Pregrado") %>%
  arrange(mrun, year) %>%
  dplyr::select(mrun, year, codigo_demre) %>%
  group_by(mrun, year) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n = n()) %>%
  filter(n == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-n)

mruns <- e %>%
  filter(!is.na(mrun) & !is.na(codigo_demre) & codigo_demre > 0 & nivel_global == "Pregrado") %>%
  dplyr::rename(year = YEAR) %>%
  dplyr::select(mrun, year, codigo_demre) %>%
  group_by(mrun, year) %>%
  tally() %>%
  arrange(-n) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  pull(mrun)

# combinations mrun-year with multiple enrollment
emult <- e %>%
  dplyr::rename(year = YEAR) %>%
  filter(mrun %in% mruns & !is.na(codigo_demre) & codigo_demre > 0 & nivel_global == "Pregrado") %>%
  arrange(mrun, year) %>%
  dplyr::select(mrun, year, codigo_demre) %>%
  group_by(mrun, year) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n = n()) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get preferences
daux <- d1 %>%
  filter(mrun %in% mruns) %>%
  dplyr::select(mrun, year, starts_with("codigo_carrera_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("codigo_carrera_"), # Columns to transform
    names_to = "preferencia", # New column for names
    names_prefix = "codigo_carrera_", # Remove prefix from names
    values_to = "codigo_carrera" # New column for values
  ) %>%
  mutate(preferencia = as.integer(preferencia)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(codigo_carrera))

efix <- merge(emult, daux %>% dplyr::rename(codigo_demre = codigo_carrera), by = c("mrun", "year", "codigo_demre"), all.x = TRUE)

ef <- rbind(
  e_single,
  efix %>% filter(!is.na(preferencia)) %>%
    group_by(mrun, year) %>%
    slice_min(preferencia, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c("n", "preferencia")) %>%
    ungroup(),
  data.frame(
    mrun = c("5329806", "5705470", "6691165", "11868262", "13939905", "14375126", "14464440", "16297790", "17345058", "18200971", "18986879", "20605322", "23865624", "24374812", "24878966"),
    codigo_demre = c("2348", "3720", "3314", "1605", "1101", "2316", "2326", "2978", "1101", "2696", "2220", "1111", "2365", "2440", "1731"),
    year = c("2008", "2008", "2010", "2009", "2010", "2010", "2007", "2007", "2011", "2009", "2009", "2009", "2007", "2008", "2009")
  )
)
```

```{r}
abc <- merge(abc, ef, by = c("mrun", "year"), all.x = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    codigo_carrera_matricula = codigo_demre,
    proceso_matricula = "ACTUAL"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-codigo_demre)

saveRDS(abc, "data/data_students_2004_2011.rds")
```


## Fix grades and scores
```{r}
d1 <- readRDS("data/data_students_2004_2011.rds")
d1 %<>% dplyr::mutate(promedio_notas = ifelse(promedio_notas >= 100, promedio_notas / 100,
  ifelse(promedio_notas > 7, 7,
    ifelse(promedio_notas <= 1, 0, promedio_notas)
  )
)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(starts_with("puntaje_"), ~ if_else(. > 10000, as.double(. / 100), as.double(.))))
saveRDS(d1, "data/data_students_2004_2011.rds")
```

```{r}
b25 %<>% dplyr::select(-ANYO_PROCESO, -FECHA_NACIMIENTO)

b24 %<>% dplyr::select(intersect(colnames(b24), colnames(b25)))

c23r %<>% dplyr::select(-PrimarioÚltimo)
colnames(c23r)[4:ncol(c23r)] <- paste0(colnames(c23r)[4:ncol(c23r)], "_REGULAR")
c23b %<>% dplyr::select(-ANYO_PROCESO, -SITUACION_POSTULANTE)
colnames(c23b)[2:ncol(c23b)] <- paste0(colnames(c23b)[2:ncol(c23b)], "_BEA")
c23p %<>% dplyr::select(-ANYO_PROCESO, -SITUACION_POSTULANTE)
colnames(c23p)[2:ncol(c23p)] <- paste0(colnames(c23p)[2:ncol(c23p)], "_PACE")

c23 <- c23r %>%
  left_join(c23b, by = "MRUN") %>%
  left_join(c23p, by = "MRUN") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(
    starts_with("PTJE"),
    ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", .))
  )) %>%
  dplyr::select(-SITUACION_POSTULANTE, -ANYO_PROCESO)
names(c23) <- gsub("_0([1-9])($|_)", "_\\1\\2", names(c23))


type_order <- c("REGULAR", "BEA", "PACE", "GENERO")

c24w <- c24 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(MRUN, SEXO, ANYO_PROCESO),
    names_from = c(ORDEN_PREF, TIPO_PREF),
    values_from = c(COD_CARRERA_PREF, ESTADO_PREF, PTJE_PREF, LUGAR_PREF),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{ORDEN_PREF}_{TIPO_PREF}"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    MRUN, SEXO, ANYO_PROCESO,
    all_of(
      names(.) %>%
        setdiff(c("MRUN", "SEXO", "ANYO_PROCESO")) %>%
        tibble(col = .) %>%
        mutate(
          # Extract X (ORDEN_PREF)
          orden = as.integer(str_extract(col, "(?<=_)[0-9]+(?=_)")),
          # Extract preference type
          tipo = str_extract(col, paste(type_order, collapse = "|")),
          tipo = factor(tipo, levels = type_order)
        ) %>%
        arrange(orden, tipo) %>%
        pull(col)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(
    starts_with("PTJE"),
    ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", .))
  )) %>%
  dplyr::select(-SEXO, -ANYO_PROCESO)

c25w <- c25 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(MRUN, SEXO, ANYO_PROCESO),
    names_from = c(ORDEN_PREF, TIPO_PREF),
    values_from = c(COD_CARRERA_PREF, ESTADO_PREF, PTJE_PREF, LUGAR_PREF),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{ORDEN_PREF}_{TIPO_PREF}"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    MRUN, SEXO, ANYO_PROCESO,
    all_of(
      names(.) %>%
        setdiff(c("MRUN", "SEXO", "ANYO_PROCESO")) %>%
        tibble(col = .) %>%
        mutate(
          # Extract X (ORDEN_PREF)
          orden = as.integer(str_extract(col, "(?<=_)[0-9]+(?=_)")),
          # Extract preference type
          tipo = str_extract(col, paste(type_order, collapse = "|")),
          tipo = factor(tipo, levels = type_order)
        ) %>%
        arrange(orden, tipo) %>%
        pull(col)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(
    starts_with("PTJE"),
    ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", .))
  )) %>%
  dplyr::select(-SEXO, -ANYO_PROCESO)

d23 %<>% dplyr::select(MRUN, CODIGO_CARRERA, VIA_ADMISION) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
```

## Compute basic outcomes
```{r}
d1 <- readRDS("data/data_students_2004_2011.rds")
d2 <- readRDS("data/data_students_2012_2022.rds")
d3 <- readRDS("data/data_students_2023_2025.rds")

d1 %<>% dplyr::select(
  -starts_with("puntpond_"),
  -c(
    "situacion_egreso", "situacion_postulante",
    "modulo_actual", "modulo_anterior", "proceso_matricula", "tipo_postulacion_matricula"
  )
)

  -starts_with("puntpond_"),
  -c(
    "situacion_egreso", "situacion_postulante",
    "modulo_actual", "modulo_anterior", "proceso_matricula", "tipo_postulacion_matricula"
  )
)
d3 %<>% dplyr::rename(nem = ptje_nem, ranking = ptje_ranking)
d3 %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  bea = ifelse(!is.na(codigo_carrera_bea_1), "BEA", ""),
  pace = ifelse(!is.na(codigo_carrera_pace_1), "PACE", "")
)
d3 %<>% dplyr::select(-starts_with("lugar_"))

d1$codigo_carrera_matricula <- as.numeric(d1$codigo_carrera_matricula)
d2$codigo_carrera_matricula <- as.numeric(d2$codigo_carrera_matricula)

```

```{r}
d %<>% group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    lenguaje_actual_norm = (lenguaje_actual - mean(lenguaje_actual, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(lenguaje_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
    matematica_actual_norm = (matematica_actual - mean(matematica_actual, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(matematica_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
    historia_actual_norm = (historia_actual - mean(historia_actual, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(historia_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
    ciencias_actual_norm = (ciencias_actual - mean(ciencias_actual, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(ciencias_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
    nem_norm = (nem - mean(nem, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(nem, na.rm = TRUE),
    ranking_norm = NA
  )

d %<>% arrange(mrun, year) %>%
  group_by(mrun) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lenguaje_actual_lag = lag(lenguaje_actual),
    matematica_actual_lag = lag(matematica_actual),
    historia_actual_lag = lag(historia_actual),
    ciencias_actual_lag = lag(ciencias_actual),
    lenguaje_actual_norm_lag = lag(lenguaje_actual_norm),
    matematica_actual_norm_lag = lag(matematica_actual_norm),
    historia_actual_norm_lag = lag(historia_actual_norm),
    ciencias_actual_norm_lag = lag(ciencias_actual_norm)
  )
```

```{r}
d %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  retake_lenguaje = ifelse(!is.na(lenguaje_actual_lag) & !is.na(lenguaje_actual),
    ifelse(lenguaje_actual_lag > 0 & lenguaje_actual > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  retake_matematica = ifelse(!is.na(matematica_actual_lag) & !is.na(matematica_actual),
    ifelse(matematica_actual_lag > 0 & matematica_actual > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  retake_historia = ifelse(!is.na(historia_actual_lag) & !is.na(historia_actual),
    ifelse(historia_actual_lag > 0 & historia_actual > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  retake_ciencias = ifelse(!is.na(ciencias_actual_lag) & !is.na(ciencias_actual),
    ifelse(ciencias_actual_lag > 0 & ciencias_actual > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  retake_lenguaje_matematica = ifelse(retake_lenguaje == 1 & retake_matematica == 1, 1, 0),
  retake_any = ifelse(retake_lenguaje == 1 | retake_matematica == 1 | retake_historia == 1 | retake_ciencias == 1, 1, 0)
) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mrun) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    num_times_retake_lenguaje = sum(retake_lenguaje),
    num_times_retake_matematica = sum(retake_matematica),
    num_times_retake_historia = sum(retake_historia),
    num_times_retake_ciencias = sum(retake_ciencias),
    num_times_retake_lenguaje_matematica = sum(retake_lenguaje_matematica),
    num_times_retake_any = sum(retake_any), rid = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
d %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  matematica_inv_actual = ifelse(!is.na(matematica_inv_actual), matematica_inv_actual,
    ifelse(!is.na(mate1_inv_actual), mate1_inv_actual, matematica_inv_actual)
  ),
  matematica_inv_anterior = ifelse(!is.na(matematica_inv_anterior), matematica_inv_anterior,
    ifelse(!is.na(mate1_inv_anterior), mate1_inv_anterior, matematica_inv_anterior)
  )
)

d %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  lenguaje_actual_twice = ifelse(!is.na(lenguaje_inv_actual) & !is.na(lenguaje_actual),
    ifelse(lenguaje_inv_actual > 0 & lenguaje_actual > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  matematica_actual_twice = ifelse(!is.na(matematica_inv_actual) & !is.na(matematica_actual),
    ifelse(matematica_inv_actual > 0 & matematica_actual > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  historia_actual_twice = ifelse(!is.na(historia_inv_actual) & !is.na(historia_actual),
    ifelse(historia_inv_actual > 0 & historia_actual > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  ciencias_actual_twice = ifelse(!is.na(ciencias_inv_actual) & !is.na(ciencias_actual),
    ifelse(ciencias_inv_actual > 0 & ciencias_actual > 0, 1, 0), 0
  )
)

d %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  lenguaje_anterior_twice = ifelse(!is.na(lenguaje_inv_anterior) & !is.na(lenguaje_anterior),
    ifelse(lenguaje_inv_anterior > 0 & lenguaje_anterior > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  matematica_anterior_twice = ifelse(!is.na(matematica_inv_anterior) & !is.na(matematica_anterior),
    ifelse(matematica_inv_anterior > 0 & matematica_anterior > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  historia_anterior_twice = ifelse(!is.na(historia_inv_anterior) & !is.na(historia_anterior),
    ifelse(historia_inv_anterior > 0 & historia_anterior > 0, 1, 0), 0
  ),
  ciencias_anterior_twice = ifelse(!is.na(ciencias_inv_anterior) & !is.na(ciencias_anterior),
    ifelse(ciencias_inv_anterior > 0 & ciencias_anterior > 0, 1, 0), 0
  )
)

d %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  num_times_take_lenguaje = (coalesce(lenguaje_inv_anterior > 0, 0) + coalesce(lenguaje_anterior > 0, 0) +
    coalesce(lenguaje_inv_actual > 0, 0) + coalesce(lenguaje_actual > 0, 0)),
  num_times_take_matematica = (coalesce(matematica_inv_anterior > 0, 0) + coalesce(matematica_anterior > 0, 0) +
    coalesce(matematica_inv_actual > 0, 0) + coalesce(matematica_actual > 0, 0)),
  num_times_take_historia = (coalesce(historia_inv_anterior > 0, 0) + coalesce(historia_anterior > 0, 0) +
    coalesce(historia_inv_actual > 0, 0) + coalesce(historia_actual > 0, 0)),
  num_times_take_ciencias = (coalesce(ciencias_inv_anterior > 0, 0) + coalesce(ciencias_anterior > 0, 0) +
    coalesce(ciencias_inv_actual > 0, 0) + coalesce(ciencias_actual > 0, 0)),
)
```


```{r}
find_marca_24 <- function(df, marca_label, codigo_label, puntaje_label, n_vars = 20) {
  # Build column names
  marca_vars <- paste0(marca_label, 1:n_vars)
  codigo_vars <- paste0(codigo_label, 1:n_vars)
  puntaje_vars <- paste0(puntaje_label, 1:n_vars)

  # Extract matrices
  marca_mat <- as.matrix(df[, marca_vars])
  codigo_mat <- as.matrix(df[, codigo_vars])
  puntaje_mat <- as.matrix(df[, puntaje_vars])

  n <- nrow(df)

  # For each row, find first position where marca == 24 (or 0 if none)
  pos_24 <- apply(marca_mat, 1, function(row) {
    idx <- which(row == 24)
    if (length(idx) == 0) 0 else idx[1]
  })

  # Initialize outputs with 0
  codigo_24 <- rep(0, n)
  puntaje_24 <- rep(0, n)
  marca_24 <- rep(0, n)

  # Rows where we actually found a 24
  has_24 <- which(pos_24 > 0)

  if (length(has_24) > 0) {
    codigo_24[has_24] <- codigo_mat[cbind(has_24, pos_24[has_24])]
    puntaje_24[has_24] <- puntaje_mat[cbind(has_24, pos_24[has_24])]
    marca_24[has_24] <- marca_mat[cbind(has_24, pos_24[has_24])]
  }

  data.frame(
    pos_24     = pos_24,
    codigo_24  = codigo_24,
    puntaje_24 = puntaje_24,
    marca_24   = marca_24
  )
}
```

## Cutoffs
```{r}
d %<>% dplyr::mutate(proceso_yyyy = ifelse(is.na(proceso_yyyy), year, proceso_yyyy))

cutoffs_reg <- d %>%
  filter(codigo_carrera_reg > 0) %>%
  group_by(proceso_yyyy, codigo_carrera_reg) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(num_assigned_reg = n(), cutoff_reg = min(puntaje_reg))
cutoffs_bea <- d %>%
  filter(codigo_carrera_bea > 0) %>%
  group_by(proceso_yyyy, codigo_carrera_bea) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(num_assigned_bea = n(), cutoff_bea = min(puntaje_bea))
cutoffs_pace <- d %>%
  filter(codigo_carrera_pace > 0) %>%
  group_by(proceso_yyyy, codigo_carrera_pace) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(num_assigned_pace = n(), cutoff_pace = min(puntaje_pace))
cutoffs_genero <- d %>%
  filter(codigo_carrera_genero > 0) %>%
  group_by(proceso_yyyy, codigo_carrera_genero) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(num_assigned_genero = n(), cutoff_genero = min(puntaje_genero))

cutoffs <- merge(cutoffs_reg, cutoffs_bea, by.x = c("codigo_carrera_reg", "proceso_yyyy"), by.y = c("codigo_carrera_bea", "proceso_yyyy"), all = TRUE)
cutoffs <- merge(cutoffs, cutoffs_pace, by.x = c("codigo_carrera_reg", "proceso_yyyy"), by.y = c("codigo_carrera_pace", "proceso_yyyy"), all = TRUE)
cutoffs <- merge(cutoffs, cutoffs_genero, by.x = c("codigo_carrera_reg", "proceso_yyyy"), by.y = c("codigo_carrera_genero", "proceso_yyyy"), all = TRUE)
cutoffs %<>% dplyr::rename(codigo_carrera = codigo_carrera_reg, year = proceso_yyyy)
```

```{r}
# remove any old cutoff/num_assigned columns
d <- d %>% dplyr::select(!(starts_with("num_assigned_") | starts_with("cutoff_")))

# create a lookup key on the cutoffs table for fast matching
cutoffs_key <- cutoffs %>% dplyr::mutate(key = paste0(codigo_carrera, "_", year))

# for each codigo_carrera_1..codigo_carrera_20, pull the cutoff and num_assigned
for (i in 1:20) {
  code_col <- paste0("codigo_carrera_", i)
  suf <- paste0("_", i)

  # build matching keys (preserve NA/0 handling)
  key_vec <- ifelse(is.na(d[[code_col]]), NA, paste0(d[[code_col]], "_", d$year))
  idx <- match(key_vec, cutoffs_key$key)

  # helper to extract a column from cutoffs_key by index, returning NA when no match
  pull_or_na <- function(col) {
    v <- rep(NA, nrow(d))
    valid <- !is.na(idx)
    v[valid] <- cutoffs_key[[col]][idx[valid]]
    v
  }

  # assign columns; set NA when codigo is 0 or NA
  is_zero_or_na <- is.na(d[[code_col]]) | d[[code_col]] == 0

  d[[paste0("cutoff_reg", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("cutoff_reg")
  d[[paste0("num_assigned_reg", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("num_assigned_reg")

  d[[paste0("cutoff_bea", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("cutoff_bea")
  d[[paste0("num_assigned_bea", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("num_assigned_bea")

  d[[paste0("cutoff_pace", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("cutoff_pace")
  d[[paste0("num_assigned_pace", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("num_assigned_pace")

  d[[paste0("cutoff_genero", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("cutoff_genero")
  d[[paste0("num_assigned_genero", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("num_assigned_genero")

  # enforce NA where codigo is 0 or NA
  for (col in c(
    paste0("cutoff_reg", suf), paste0("num_assigned_reg", suf),
    paste0("cutoff_bea", suf), paste0("num_assigned_bea", suf),
    paste0("cutoff_pace", suf), paste0("num_assigned_pace", suf),
    paste0("cutoff_genero", suf), paste0("num_assigned_genero", suf)
  )) {
    d[[col]][is_zero_or_na] <- NA
  }
}

# now, for each codigo_carrera_X, compute distance_to_cutoff_X as puntaje_X - cutoff_X for each of reg, bea, pace, genero
for (i in 1:20) {
  suf <- paste0("_", i)
  for (type in c("reg", "bea", "pace", "genero")) {
    puntaje_col <- paste0("puntaje", suf)
    cutoff_col <- paste0("cutoff_", type, suf)
    dist_col <- paste0("dist_to_cutoff_", type, suf)
    below_col <- paste0("below_cutoff_", type, suf)
    d[[dist_col]] <- ifelse(!is.na(d[[puntaje_col]]) & d[[puntaje_col]] != 0 & !is.na(d[[cutoff_col]]),
      d[[puntaje_col]] - d[[cutoff_col]], NA
    )
    d[[below_col]] <- ifelse(!is.na(d[[dist_col]]), d[[dist_col]] < 0, NA)
  }
}

saveRDS(d, paste0(code_R_dir, "data/data_students_2004_2025.rds"))
```

## Adding admissibility mistakes
```{r}
d <- readRDS("data/data_students_2004_2025.rds")

d %<>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    applied_reg = purrr::pmap_int(
      select(., starts_with("codigo_carrera_")),
      function(...) {
        row <- c(...)
        valid_values <- row[!is.na(row) & row != 0]
        if (length(valid_values) > 0) 1 else 0
      }
    ),
    assigned_reg = apply(select(., starts_with("marca_") & !starts_with("marca_pace_")), 1, function(row) {
      # Remove NA and zero values
      valid_values <- row[!is.na(row) & row != 0 & row == 24]
      # Check if all valid values are NOT in c(24, 25, 26)
      if (length(valid_values) > 0) {
        return(1)
      } else {
        return(0)
      }
    }),
    assigned_bea = apply(select(., starts_with("marca_bea_")), 1, function(row) {
      # Remove NA and zero values
      valid_values <- row[!is.na(row) & row != 0 & row == 24]
      # Check if all valid values are NOT in c(24, 25, 26)
      if (length(valid_values) > 0) {
        return(1)
      } else {
        return(0)
      }
    }),
    all_mistakes_reg = apply(select(., starts_with("marca_")), 1, function(row) {
      # Remove NA and zero values
      valid_values <- row[!is.na(row) & row != 0]
      # Check if all valid values are NOT in c(24, 25, 26)
      if (length(valid_values) > 0 && all(!valid_values %in% c(24, 25, 26))) {
        return(1)
      } else {
        return(0)
      }
    }),
    any_mistake_reg = apply(select(., starts_with("marca_")), 1, function(row) {
      # Remove NA and zero values
      valid_values <- row[!is.na(row) & row != 0]
      # Check if any valid value is NOT in c(24, 25, 26)
      if (any(!valid_values %in% c(24, 25, 26))) {
        return(1)
      } else {
        return(0)
      }
    })
  )

d %<>%
  mutate(
    applied_pace = purrr::pmap_int(
      select(., starts_with("codigo_carrera_pace_")),
      function(...) {
        row <- c(...)
        valid_values <- row[!is.na(row) & row != 0]
        if (length(valid_values) > 0) 1 else 0
      }
    ),
    assigned_pace = apply(select(., starts_with("marca_pace_")), 1, function(row) {
      # Remove NA and zero values
      valid_values <- row[!is.na(row) & row != 0 & row == 24]
      # Check if all valid values are NOT in c(24, 25, 26)
      if (length(valid_values) > 0) {
        return(1)
      } else {
        return(0)
      }
    }),
    all_mistakes_pace = apply(select(., starts_with("marca_pace_")), 1, function(row) {
      # Remove NA and zero values
      valid_values <- row[!is.na(row) & row != 0]
      # Check if all valid values are NOT in c(24, 25, 26)
      if (length(valid_values) > 0 && all(!valid_values %in% c(24, 25, 26))) {
        return(1)
      } else {
        return(0)
      }
    }),
    any_mistake_pace = apply(select(., starts_with("marca_pace_")), 1, function(row) {
      # Remove NA and zero values
      valid_values <- row[!is.na(row) & row != 0]
      # Check if any valid value is NOT in c(24, 25, 26)

# fix grades
d %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  promedio_notas = ifelse(promedio_notas < 1, promedio_notas * 10, promedio_notas),
  applied = ifelse(applied_reg + applied_pace > 0, 1, 0),
  assigned = ifelse(assigned_reg + assigned_bea + assigned_pace > 0, 1, 0),
  enrolled = ifelse(!is.na(codigo_carrera_matricula), 1, 0),
  scored_lm = ifelse(is.na(lenguaje_actual) | is.na(matematica_actual), 0,
    ifelse(lenguaje_actual > 0 & matematica_actual > 0, 1, 0)
  ),
  scored_any = ifelse(is.na(lenguaje_actual) | is.na(matematica_actual) | is.na(historia_actual) | is.na(ciencias_actual), 0,
    ifelse(lenguaje_actual > 0 | matematica_actual > 0 | historia_actual > 0 | ciencias_actual > 0, 1, 0)
  ),
  any_mistake = ifelse((any_mistake_pace == 1 & applied_pace == 1) | (any_mistake_reg == 1 & applied_reg == 1), 1, 0),
  all_mistakes = ifelse(((all_mistakes_pace == 1 & applied_pace == 1) | applied_pace == 0) & (all_mistakes_reg == 1 & applied_reg == 1), 1, 0),
  prom_lm_actual = (lenguaje_actual + matematica_actual) / 2,

  dist_cutoff_pace_1 = (puntaje_1 - cutoff_pace),
  dist_cutoff_1 = ifelse(is_bea == 1, dist_cutoff_bea_1, dist_cutoff_reg_1),

)
```

## Compute lags
```{r}
d <- readRDS("data/data_students_2004_2025.rds")

dt <- as.data.table(d)
setkey(dt, mrun, year)
rm(d)
gc(reset = TRUE)

dt[, `:=`(
  year_prev = shift(year, type = "lag"),
  applied_lag = shift(applied, type = "lag"),
  assigned_lag = shift(assigned, type = "lag"),
  enrolled_lag = shift(enrolled, type = "lag"),
  year_next = shift(year, type = "lead"),
  applied_lead = shift(applied, type = "lead"),
  assigned_lead = shift(assigned, type = "lead"),
  enrolled_lead = shift(enrolled, type = "lead"),
  scored_lm_lag = shift(scored_lm, type = "lag"),
  scored_any_lag = shift(scored_any, type = "lag"),
  scored_lm_lead = shift(scored_lm, type = "lead"),
  scored_any_lead = shift(scored_any, type = "lead"),
  scored_lm_cumsum = cumsum(scored_lm),
  applied_cumsum = cumsum(applied),
  assigned_cumsum = cumsum(assigned),
  enrolled_cumsum = cumsum(enrolled),
  scored_lm_total = sum(scored_lm),
  applied_total = sum(applied),
  assigned_total = sum(assigned),
  enrolled_total = sum(enrolled)
), by = mrun]


d <- as.data.frame(dt)
rm(dt)
gc(reset = TRUE)

d <- d %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    scored_lm_cumsum_past = scored_lm_cumsum - scored_lm,
    applied_cumsum_past = applied_cumsum - applied,
    assigned_cumsum_past = assigned_cumsum - assigned,
    enrolled_cumsum_past = enrolled_cumsum - enrolled,
    scored_lm_cumsum_post = scored_lm_total - scored_lm_cumsum,
    applied_cumsum_post = applied_total - applied_cumsum,
    assigned_cumsum_post = assigned_total - assigned_cumsum,
    enrolled_cumsum_post = enrolled_total - enrolled_cumsum,
    scored_lm_prev = ifelse(is.na(scored_lm_lag), 0, ifelse(scored_lm_lag == 1 & year == year_prev + 1, 1, 0)),
    scored_lm_past = ifelse(is.na(scored_lm_cumsum_past), 0, ifelse(scored_lm_cumsum_past > 0, 1, 0)),
    applied_prev = ifelse(is.na(applied_lag), 0, ifelse(applied_lag == 1 & year == year_prev + 1, 1, 0)),
    applied_past = ifelse(is.na(applied_cumsum_past), 0, ifelse(applied_cumsum_past > 0, 1, 0)),
    assigned_prev = ifelse(is.na(assigned_lag), 0, ifelse(assigned_lag == 1 & year == year_prev + 1, 1, 0)),
    assigned_past = ifelse(is.na(assigned_cumsum_past), 0, ifelse(assigned_cumsum_past > 0, 1, 0)),
    enrolled_prev = ifelse(is.na(enrolled_lag), 0, ifelse(enrolled_lag == 1 & year == year_prev + 1, 1, 0)),
    enrolled_past = ifelse(is.na(enrolled_cumsum_past), 0, ifelse(enrolled_cumsum_past > 0, 1, 0)),
    scored_lm_next = ifelse(is.na(scored_lm_lead), 0, ifelse(scored_lm_lead == 1 & year == year_next - 1, 1, 0)),
    scored_lm_post = ifelse(is.na(scored_lm_cumsum_post), 0, ifelse(scored_lm_cumsum_post > 0, 1, 0)),
    applied_next = ifelse(is.na(applied_lead), 0, ifelse(applied_lead == 1 & year == year_next - 1, 1, 0)),
    applied_post = ifelse(is.na(applied_cumsum_post), 0, ifelse(applied_cumsum_post > 0, 1, 0)),
    assigned_next = ifelse(is.na(assigned_lead), 0, ifelse(assigned_lead == 1 & year == year_next - 1, 1, 0)),
    assigned_post = ifelse(is.na(assigned_cumsum_post), 0, ifelse(assigned_cumsum_post > 0, 1, 0)),
    enrolled_next = ifelse(is.na(enrolled_lead), 0, ifelse(enrolled_lead == 1 & year == year_next - 1, 1, 0)),
    enrolled_post = ifelse(is.na(enrolled_cumsum_post), 0, ifelse(enrolled_cumsum_post > 0, 1, 0)),
    rescored_lm_prev = scored_lm * scored_lm_prev, rescored_lm_past = scored_lm * scored_lm_past,
    reapplied_prev = applied * applied_prev, reapplied_past = applied * applied_past,
    reassigned_prev = assigned * assigned_prev, reassigned_past = assigned * assigned_past,
    reenrolled_prev = enrolled * enrolled_prev, reenrolled_past = enrolled * enrolled_past,
    rescored_lm_next = scored_lm * scored_lm_next, rescored_lm_post = scored_lm * scored_lm_post,
    reapplied_next = applied * applied_next, reapplied_post = applied * applied_post,
    reassigned_next = assigned * assigned_next, reassigned_post = assigned * assigned_post,
    reenrolled_next = enrolled * enrolled_next, reenrolled_post = enrolled * enrolled_post,
    rescored_lm_ever = ifelse(scored_lm_total > 1, 1, 0)
  )

# compute 1- and 2-period lags and leads of prom_lm_actual for each student (mrun)
# next = lead(1), post = lead(2), prev = lag(1), past = lag(2)
dt2 <- data.table::as.data.table(d)
data.table::setorder(dt2, mrun, year)
dt2[, `:=`(
  prom_lm_actual_prev = data.table::shift(prom_lm_actual, 1, type = "lag"),
  prom_lm_actual_past = data.table::shift(prom_lm_actual, 2, type = "lag"),
  prom_lm_actual_next = data.table::shift(prom_lm_actual, 1, type = "lead"),
  prom_lm_actual_post = data.table::shift(prom_lm_actual, 2, type = "lead"),
  prom_lm_actual_norm_prev = data.table::shift(prom_lm_actual_norm, 1, type = "lag"),
  prom_lm_actual_norm_past = data.table::shift(prom_lm_actual_norm, 2, type = "lag"),
  prom_lm_actual_norm_next = data.table::shift(prom_lm_actual_norm, 1, type = "lead"),
  prom_lm_actual_norm_post = data.table::shift(prom_lm_actual_norm, 2, type = "lead")
), by = mrun]

d <- as.data.frame(dt2)
rm(dt2)
gc(reset = TRUE)

dt2 <- data.table::as.data.table(d)
data.table::setorder(dt2, mrun, year)
dt2[, `:=`(
  below_cutoff_reg_1_prev = data.table::shift(below_cutoff_reg_1, 1, type = "lag"),
  below_cutoff_reg_1_past = data.table::shift(below_cutoff_reg_1, 2, type = "lag"),
  below_cutoff_reg_1_next = data.table::shift(below_cutoff_reg_1, 1, type = "lead"),
  below_cutoff_reg_1_post = data.table::shift(below_cutoff_reg_1, 2, type = "lead"),
  dist_to_cutoff_reg_1_prev = data.table::shift(dist_to_cutoff_reg_1, 1, type = "lag"),
  dist_to_cutoff_reg_1_past = data.table::shift(dist_to_cutoff_reg_1, 2, type = "lag"),
  dist_to_cutoff_reg_1_next = data.table::shift(dist_to_cutoff_reg_1, 1, type = "lead"),
  dist_to_cutoff_reg_1_post = data.table::shift(dist_to_cutoff_reg_1, 2, type = "lead")
), by = mrun]

d <- as.data.frame(dt2)
rm(dt2)
gc(reset = TRUE)

saveRDS(d, paste0(code_R_dir, "data/data_students_2004_2025.rds"))
```

```{r , echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
car <- readRDS("data/panel_programs_2012_2025.rds")

cutoffs <- car %>%
  dplyr::select(codigo_demre, YEAR, cutoff_reg, cutoff_bea, cutoff_pace, cutoff_genero) %>%
  dplyr::rename(codigo_carrera = codigo_demre, year = YEAR) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(codigo_carrera) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    prev_cutoff_reg = dplyr::lag(cutoff_reg),
    prev_cutoff_bea = dplyr::lag(cutoff_bea),
    prev_cutoff_pace = dplyr::lag(cutoff_pace),
    prev_cutoff_genero = dplyr::lag(cutoff_genero)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

d <- demre %>% dplyr::select(!(starts_with("prev_cutoff_")))

# create a lookup key on the cutoffs table for fast matching
cutoffs_key <- cutoffs %>% dplyr::mutate(key = paste0(codigo_carrera, "_", year))

# for each codigo_carrera_1..codigo_carrera_20, pull the cutoff and num_assigned
for (i in 1:20) {
  code_col <- paste0("codigo_carrera_", i)
  suf <- paste0("_", i)

  # build matching keys (preserve NA/0 handling)
  key_vec <- ifelse(is.na(d[[code_col]]), NA, paste0(d[[code_col]], "_", d$year))
  idx <- match(key_vec, cutoffs_key$key)

  # helper to extract a column from cutoffs_key by index, returning NA when no match
  pull_or_na <- function(col) {
    v <- rep(NA, nrow(d))
    valid <- !is.na(idx)
    v[valid] <- cutoffs_key[[col]][idx[valid]]
    v
  }

  # assign columns; set NA when codigo is 0 or NA
  is_zero_or_na <- is.na(d[[code_col]]) | d[[code_col]] == 0

  d[[paste0("prev_cutoff_reg", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("prev_cutoff_reg")
  d[[paste0("prev_cutoff_bea", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("prev_cutoff_bea")
  d[[paste0("prev_cutoff_pace", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("prev_cutoff_pace")
  d[[paste0("prev_cutoff_genero", suf)]] <- pull_or_na("prev_cutoff_genero")

  # enforce NA where codigo is 0 or NA
  for (col in c(
    paste0("prev_cutoff_reg", suf),
    paste0("prev_cutoff_bea", suf),
    paste0("prev_cutoff_pace", suf),
    paste0("prev_cutoff_genero", suf)
  )) {
    d[[col]][is_zero_or_na] <- NA
  }
}


car %<>% dplyr::rename(
  pct_lenguaje = PCT_LENG,
  pct_matematica = PCT_MATE,
  pct_ciencias = PCT_CIEN,
  pct_historia = PCT_HYCS,
  pct_nem = PCT_NEM,
  pct_ranking = PCT_RANK
)
car %<>% dplyr::rename(codigo_carrera = codigo_demre, year = YEAR)

compute_max_sumproduct <- function(d, car) {
  # Loop over i = 1..20
  for (i in 1:20) {
    # Column names
    cod_col <- paste0("codigo_carrera_", i)
    punt_col <- paste0("puntaje_", i)
    marc_col <- paste0("marca_", i)

    # Extract the pair (codigo_carrera_i, year)
    tmp <- d %>%
      select(!!cod_col, year) %>%
      rename(codigo_carrera = !!cod_col)

    # Join the weights for this i
    tmp2 <- tmp %>%
      left_join(car, by = c("codigo_carrera", "year"))

    # Extract weights (now aligned row-by-row)
    w_leng <- tmp2$pct_lenguaje
    w_mate <- tmp2$pct_matematica
    w_cien <- tmp2$pct_ciencias
    w_hist <- tmp2$pct_historia
    w_nem <- tmp2$pct_nem
    w_ranking <- tmp2$pct_ranking

    # Compute weighted sums for this i
    sum_actual_i <- w_leng * d$lenguaje_actual +
      w_mate * d$matematica_actual +
      w_cien * d$ciencias_actual +
      w_hist * d$historia_actual +
      w_nem * d$nem +
      w_ranking * d$ranking

    sum_anterior_i <- w_leng * d$lenguaje_anterior +
      w_mate * d$matematica_anterior +
      w_cien * d$ciencias_anterior +
      w_hist * d$historia_anterior +
      w_nem * d$nem +
      w_ranking * d$ranking

    # Condition for this i
    cond <- !is.na(d[[cod_col]]) &
      d[[cod_col]] > 0 &
      (is.na(d[[punt_col]]) | d[[punt_col]] == 0) &
      d[[marc_col]] == 26

    # Output column
    out_col <- paste0("repuntaje_", i)
    out_col2 <- paste0("above_prev_cutoff_reg_", i)
    d[[out_col]] <- ifelse(cond, pmax(sum_actual_i, sum_anterior_i) / 100, d[[punt_col]])
    d[[out_col2]] <- ifelse(!is.na(d[[out_col]]) & !is.na(d[[paste0("prev_cutoff_reg_", i)]]),
      d[[out_col]] >= d[[paste0("prev_cutoff_reg_", i)]], NA
    )
  }
  d
}

d <- compute_max_sumproduct(d, car)

d %<>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    num_apps_above_prev_cutoff_reg = rowSums(
      across(
        num_range("above_prev_cutoff_reg_", 1:20),
        ~ .x & !is.na(.x)
      )
    )
  )

d %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  pct_apps_above_prev_cutoff_reg = ifelse(num_apps_reg > 0, num_apps_above_prev_cutoff_reg / num_apps_reg, NA),
  any_apps_above_prev_cutoff = ifelse(num_apps_reg > 0, ifelse(num_apps_above_prev_cutoff_reg > 0, 1, 0), NA)
)
saveRDS(d, "data/data_students_2004_2025.rds")
```

```{r unify_car, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
clean_car_data <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      EXIGE_MATE2 = ifelse(is.na(EXIGE_MATE2) | EXIGE_MATE2 %in% c("", "N"), 0,
        ifelse(EXIGE_MATE2 == "S", 1, 0)
      ),
      PCT_HYCS = ifelse(is.na(PCT_HYCS), 0, PCT_HYCS),
      PCT_CIEN = ifelse(is.na(PCT_CIEN), 0, PCT_CIEN),
      RESTRINGE_SEXO = ifelse(
        is.na(RESTRINGE_SEXO), 0,
        ifelse(RESTRINGE_SEXO %in% c("NO", "0", ""), 0,
          ifelse(RESTRINGE_SEXO %in% c("SI", "1", "2", "SOLO DAMAS", "SOLO VARONES", "F", "M"),
            1, RESTRINGE_SEXO
          )
        )
      ),
      RESTRINGE_SEXO = as.numeric(RESTRINGE_SEXO),
      TIPO_PE = ifelse(
        is.na(TIPO_PE), 0,
        ifelse(TIPO_PE %in% c("NO", "0", "", " "), 0,
          ifelse(TIPO_PE == "PONDERA", 1,
            ifelse(TIPO_PE == "EXCLUYE", 2, TIPO_PE)
          )
        )
      ),
      TIPO_PE = as.numeric(TIPO_PE),
      PCT_PE = ifelse(is.na(PCT_PE), 0, PCT_PE),
      PONDERADO_MINIMO = ifelse(is.na(PONDERADO_MINIMO), 0, PONDERADO_MINIMO),
      SC_1SEM = ifelse(is.na(SC_1SEM), 0, SC_1SEM),
      SC_2SEM = ifelse(is.na(SC_2SEM), 0, SC_2SEM),
      VAC_2SEM = ifelse(is.na(VAC_2SEM), 0, VAC_2SEM),
      PRUEBA_ESPECIAL = ifelse(
        is.na(PRUEBA_ESPECIAL), 0,
        ifelse(PRUEBA_ESPECIAL == "NO", 0,
          ifelse(PRUEBA_ESPECIAL == "SI", 1, PRUEBA_ESPECIAL)
        )
      ),
      PRUEBA_ESPECIAL = as.numeric(PRUEBA_ESPECIAL),
      PO_ALTERNATIVA = ifelse(
        is.na(PO_ALTERNATIVA), 0,
        ifelse(PO_ALTERNATIVA == "NO", 0,
          ifelse(PO_ALTERNATIVA == "SI", 1, PO_ALTERNATIVA)
        )
      ),
      PO_ALTERNATIVA = as.numeric(PO_ALTERNATIVA),
      MAX_POST = ifelse(is.na(MAX_POST), 0, MAX_POST),
      EXCLUYE_DESDE_PREFERENCIA = ifelse(is.na(EXCLUYE_DESDE_PREFERENCIA), 0, EXCLUYE_DESDE_PREFERENCIA),
      CDP_VACANTES_ESPECIALES = ifelse(is.na(CDP_VACANTES_ESPECIALES), 0, CDP_VACANTES_ESPECIALES)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(VAC_BEA = ifelse(!is.na(CDP_VACANTES_ESPECIALES), CDP_VACANTES_ESPECIALES, VAC_BEA)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-CDP_VACANTES_ESPECIALES) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(CODIGO, YEAR)
}
df_list <- list(c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, c24, c25)
all_cols <- Reduce(union, lapply(df_list, names))

# 2. helper to add missing columns
add_missing_cols <- function(df, all_cols) {
  missing <- setdiff(all_cols, names(df))
  # Create missing columns as NA_real_ (numeric NA)
  for (m in missing) {
    df[[m]] <- NA_real_
  }
  df
}

# 3. apply to each df
cleaned_list <- lapply(df_list, function(df) {
  df %>%
    add_missing_cols(all_cols) %>%
    clean_car_data()
})

c <- bind_rows(cleaned_list)
```

```{r add_cutoff_percentile, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
c %<>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    num_seats_reg = VAC_1SEM + VAC_2SEM + SC_1SEM + SC_2SEM,
    num_seats_bea = VAC_BEA,
    full_reg = ifelse(num_assigned_reg >= num_seats_reg, 1, 0),
    full_bea = ifelse(num_assigned_bea >= num_seats_bea, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    score_last_reg = cutoff_reg,
    score_last_bea = cutoff_bea,
    cutoff_reg = ifelse(full_reg == 1, cutoff_reg, 0),
    cutoff_bea = ifelse(full_bea == 1, cutoff_bea, 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(YEAR) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct5_reg = quantile(cutoff_reg, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct10_reg = quantile(cutoff_reg, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct25_reg = quantile(cutoff_reg, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct50_reg = quantile(cutoff_reg, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct75_reg = quantile(cutoff_reg, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct90_reg = quantile(cutoff_reg, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct95_reg = quantile(cutoff_reg, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct99_reg = quantile(cutoff_reg, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    top95_reg = as.integer(cutoff_reg >= pct5_reg),
    top90_reg = as.integer(cutoff_reg >= pct10_reg),
    top75_reg = as.integer(cutoff_reg >= pct25_reg),
    top50_reg = as.integer(cutoff_reg >= pct50_reg),
    top25_reg = as.integer(cutoff_reg >= pct75_reg),
    top10_reg = as.integer(cutoff_reg >= pct90_reg),
    top5_reg = as.integer(cutoff_reg >= pct95_reg),
    top1_reg = as.integer(cutoff_reg >= pct99_reg),
    pct10_bea = quantile(cutoff_bea, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct25_bea = quantile(cutoff_bea, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct50_bea = quantile(cutoff_bea, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct75_bea = quantile(cutoff_bea, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct90_bea = quantile(cutoff_bea, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct99_bea = quantile(cutoff_bea, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    top90_bea = as.integer(cutoff_bea >= pct10_bea),
    top75_bea = as.integer(cutoff_bea >= pct25_bea),
    top50_bea = as.integer(cutoff_bea >= pct50_bea),
    top25_bea = as.integer(cutoff_bea >= pct75_bea),
    top10_bea = as.integer(cutoff_bea >= pct90_bea),
    top1_bea = as.integer(cutoff_bea >= pct99_bea),
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

```{r}
eg_sub <- merge(e_sub, g_sub %>% dplyr::select(c("mrun", "codigo_unico")) %>% dplyr::mutate(graduated = 1), by = c("mrun", "codigo_unico"), all.x = TRUE)
eg_sub$graduated[is.na(eg_sub$graduated)] <- 0

eg_sub %<>% group_by(YEAR, mrun, codigo_unico) %>%
  mutate(rid = row_number()) %>%
  filter(rid == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(anio_ing_carr_act = ifelse(!is.na(anio_ing_carr_act), anio_ing_carr_act, ifelse(abs(anio_ing_carr_ori - YEAR) <= 1, anio_ing_carr_ori, anio_ing_carr_act))) %>%
  arrange(mrun, codigo_unico, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_unico) %>%
  fill(anio_ing_carr_act, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(anio_ing_carr_act, .direction = "up") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, nomb_carrera, nomb_inst) %>%
  fill(anio_ing_carr_act, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(anio_ing_carr_act, .direction = "up") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, codigo_unico, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_unico) %>%
  mutate(anio_ing_carr_act = ifelse(is.na(anio_ing_carr_act), min(anio_ing_carr_act, na.rm = TRUE), anio_ing_carr_act)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, codigo_unico, YEAR) %>%

    anio_ing_carr_act = ifelse(anio_ing_carr_act != min(anio_ing_carr_act, na.rm = TRUE), min(anio_ing_carr_act, na.rm = TRUE), anio_ing_carr_act),
    anio_ing_carr_ori = ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori != min(anio_ing_carr_ori, na.rm = TRUE), min(anio_ing_carr_ori, na.rm = TRUE), anio_ing_carr_ori)

  fill(anio_ing_carr_act, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(anio_ing_carr_act, .direction = "up") %>%
  ungroup() %>%

eg_sub %<>% group_by(mrun, codigo_unico) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(anio_ing_carr_ori = ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori %in% c(1900, 9995, 9998, 9999), min(anio_ing_carr_act, na.rm = TRUE), anio_ing_carr_ori))

eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, codigo_unico, YEAR) %>%

  mutate(anio_ing_carr_act = ifelse(is.na(anio_ing_carr_act), min(YEAR, na.rm = TRUE), anio_ing_carr_act)) %>%

eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, codigo_unico, YEAR) %>%

eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, codigo_unico, YEAR) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(codigo_demre = ifelse(codigo_demre == 0, NA, codigo_demre)) %>%

eg_sub %<>% dplyr::mutate(anio_ing_carr_ori = ifelse(is.na(anio_ing_carr_ori), anio_ing_carr_act, anio_ing_carr_ori))

eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, nomb_inst, anio_ing_carr_act) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(anio_ing_carr_ori = cummax(anio_ing_carr_ori))

eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, nomb_inst, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, nomb_inst) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(anio_ing_carr_ori = ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori < cummax(anio_ing_carr_ori), cummax(anio_ing_carr_ori), anio_ing_carr_ori))
```

We have data starting from 2007; so, if a student has a record that says they started before that, then I replace to prevent problems.
In other words, a student cannot start its current program in a year post the year he did first year.
```{r}
eg_sub %<>% group_by(mrun) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    anio_ing_carr_act =
      ifelse(anio_ing_carr_act >= min(YEAR, na.rm = TRUE), anio_ing_carr_act,
        ifelse(anio_ing_carr_act < anio_ing_carr_ori, anio_ing_carr_ori, anio_ing_carr_act)
      ),
    anio_ing_carr_ori = ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori <= anio_ing_carr_act, anio_ing_carr_ori, anio_ing_carr_act)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

Remove special names involving specialization, etc, as they make the matching process of names more complicated.

```{r}
# Escape parentheses in the keywords
escape_special_chars <- function(keywords) {
  str_replace_all(keywords, "\\(", "\\\\(") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\)", "\\\\)")
}

keywords_a <- escape_special_chars(keywords_a)
keywords_b <- escape_special_chars(keywords_b)

# Create regex patterns
keywords_a_pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(keywords_a, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")
keywords_b_pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(keywords_b, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")


eg_sub %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  nomb_inst_original = nomb_inst,
  nomb_inst = nomb_inst %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s*\\([^)]*\\)", "") %>%
    str_replace(",.*", "") %>%
    str_trim()
)

eg_sub %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  # nomb_carrera_original = nomb_carrera,
  nomb_carrera = nomb_carrera_original %>%
    # # If a keyword is at the beginning, remove only the keyword
    str_replace_all(paste0("^", keywords_a_pattern), "") %>%
    # If a keyword is anywhere else, remove everything from the keyword onwards
    str_replace_all(paste0(keywords_b_pattern, ".*"), "") %>%
    str_replace("/.*", "") %>%
    str_replace("\\(.*", "") %>%
    str_replace("ON-LINE", "") %>% str_replace("E-BUSINESS", "") %>%
    str_replace("GESTION INFORMACION", "GESTION DE LA INFORMACION") %>% str_replace("GESTION DE INFORMACION", "GESTION DE LA INFORMACION") %>%
    str_replace("-.*", "") %>%
    str_replace(",.*", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("NUTRICION\\b.*", "NUTRICION") %>%
    str_replace_all("OBSTETRICIA\\b.*", "OBSTETRICIA") %>%
    str_replace_all("TECNOLOGIA MEDICA\\b.*", "TECNOLOGIA MEDICA") %>%
    str_replace_all("INFORMAT. PROS. DE ESTUDIOS", "INFORMATICA") %>%
    str_replace_all("MATEMATICAS", "MATEMATICA") %>%
    str_replace_all("TRAUCTOLOGIA", "TRADUCTOLOGIA") %>%
    str_replace_all("SOCIOLOGO", "SOCIOLOGIA") %>%
    str_replace("COMUNICADOR", "COMUNICACION ") %>%
    str_replace("PUBLICISTA", "PUBLICIDAD ") %>%
    str_replace_all("PUBLICIDAD\\b.*", "PUBLICIDAD") %>%
    str_replace_all("PERIODISMO\\b.*", "PERIODISMO") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN RELIGION\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN RELIGION") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN QUIMICA\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN QUIMICA") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN MATEMATICA\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN MATEMATICA") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN LENGUAJE\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN LENGUAJE") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN MUSICA\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN MUSICA") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN INGLES\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN INGLES") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN HISTORIA\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN HISTORIA") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN FISICA\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN FISICA") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN EDUCACION FISICA\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN EDUCACION FISICA") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN EDUCACION ESPECIAL\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN EDUCACION ESPECIAL") %>%
    str_replace("PEDAGOGIA EN CIENCIA", "PEDAGOGIA EN CIENCIAS") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN CIENCIAS\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN CIENCIAS") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN CASTELLANO\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN CASTELLANO") %>%
    str_replace_all("PEDAGOGIA EN BIOLOGIA\\b.*", "PEDAGOGIA EN BIOLOGIA") %>%
    str_replace_all("ACTUACION\\b.*", "ACTUACION") %>%
    str_replace_all("ENFERMERIA\\b.*", "ENFERMERIA") %>%
    str_replace_all("ANIMACION\\b.*", "ANIMACION") %>%
    str_replace_all("ANTROPOLOGIA\\b.*", "ANTROPOLOGIA") %>%
    str_replace_all("ADMINISTRACION PUBLICA\\b.*", "ADMINISTRACION PUBLICA") %>%
    str_replace("TRADUCTOR", "TRADUCCION ") %>%
    str_replace("ADMINISTRADOR", "ADMINISTRACION ") %>%
    str_replace("TURISTICO", "TURISTICA ") %>%

    str_replace("GEOMENSURA", "GEOMESURA") %>%
    str_replace("MANTENIMIENTO", "MANTENCION") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\b(EN|CON|DE|PARA|A|POR|AL)\\b\\s*", "") %>%
    str_replace("INGENIERIA.*?EJECUCION", "INGENIERIA EJECUCION") %>%
    str_replace("(EJECUCION)\\s+(EN|DE|PARA|CON)\\b", "\\1") %>%
    str_replace("(CIVIL)\\s+(EN|DE|PARA|CON)\\b", "\\1") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s*\\([^)]*\\)", "") %>%
    str_replace("TITULACION", "") %>% str_replace("TITULACION EN", "") %>% str_replace("TITULACION DE", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("TRADUCCION\\b.*", "TRADUCCION") %>%
    str_replace_all("INGENIERIA EN PREVENCION DE RIESGOS\\b.*", "INGENIERIA EN PREVENCION DE RIESGOS") %>%
    str_replace("P.A.E.", "") %>% str_replace("Y NB1", "") %>% str_replace("1ºS AFIN", "") %>%
    str_replace_all(paste0("\\b(", paste(c("EN PLAN COMUN", "PLAN COMUN", "PLAN COMUN DE"), collapse = "|"), ")\\b"), "") %>%
    str_replace_all(paste0("\\b(", paste(c(
      "REGULARIZACION", "REGULARIZACION EN", "REGULARIZACION DE TITULO",
      "PROGRAMA DE CONTINUIDAD DE ESTUDIO A",
      "REGULARIZACION DE TITULO DE", "REGULARIZACION DE ENSEÑANZA",
      "REGULARIZACION DE EDUCACION"
    ), collapse = "|"), ")\\b"), "") %>%
    str_replace_all(paste0("\\b(", paste(c("PET", "PET DE", "PLAN COMUN DE"), collapse = "|"), ")\\b"), "") %>%
    # Trim whitespace
    str_trim()
)

eg_sub %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  nomb_carrera = ifelse(nomb_carrera == "", nomb_carrera_original, nomb_carrera),
  nomb_carrera = nomb_carrera %>%
    str_replace_all(paste0(
      "\\b(",
      paste(c(
        "PLAN COMUN", "PROGRAMA DE PROSECUCION DE ESTUDIOS",
        "CONTINUIDAD", "MENCION ESTILO AMBIENTAL",
        "(PLAN DE CONTINUIDAD DE ESTUDIOS)", "INGRESO CICLO COMUN FACULTAD DE",
        "P/E REGULARIZACION PARA", "PCE", "PSE",
        "PLAN COMPLEMENTACION DE", "PLAN COMPLEMENTARIO DE",
        "PLAN DE CONTINUIDAD DE ESTUDIOS EN", "PLAN ESPECIAL", "PLAN ESPECIAL:",
        "PROGRAMA DE CONTINUIDAD DE ESTUDIO A", "PROGRAMA DE CONTINUIDAD DE ESTUDIOS",
        "PROGRAMA DE CONTINUIDAD DE ESTUDIOS EN", "PROGRAMA DE CONTINUIDAD DE ESTUDIOS DE",
        "PROGRAMA DE PROSECUCION DE ESTUDIOS DE", "PROGRAMA DE PROSECUCION DE ESTUDIOS",
        "PROGRAMA DE REGULARIZACION PARA", "PROSECUCION DE ESTUDIOS A",
        "PROSECUCION DE ESTUDIOS", "PROSECUCION DE ESTUDIOS EN",
        "PROSECUCION DE ESTUDIOS DE", "PROSECUCION ESTUDIOS CONDUCENTE AL TITULO DE",
        " (LICENCIATURA)"
      ), collapse = "|"), ")\\b"
    ), "") %>%
    str_replace_all("INGENIERIA COMERCIAL\\b.*", "INGENIERIA COMERCIAL") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\b(EN|CON|DE|PARA|A|POR|AL)\\b\\s*", "") %>%

eg_sub %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  codigo_demre =
    ifelse(nomb_inst == "UNIVERSIDAD ADOLFO IBAÑEZ" & grepl("INGENIERIA CIVIL", nomb_carrera),
      ifelse(region_sede == "Metropolitana", 42002, 42022), codigo_demre
    )
)

eg_sub %<>% ungroup %>%
  group_by(nomb_carrera, nomb_inst) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(codigo_adicional = cur_group_id()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_adicional) %>%
  fill(codigo_demre, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(codigo_demre, .direction = "up") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()


## Step 0: start and initiate
eg_sub %<>% group_by(mrun) %>% dplyr::mutate(
  initiated = ifelse(YEAR == min(YEAR, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0), # initiated = first time in higher education
  started = ifelse(initiated == 1 | YEAR == anio_ing_carr_ori, 1, 0)
) # started = first time in university

eg_sub %<>% group_by(mrun, codigo_adicional) %>% dplyr::mutate(started = ifelse(YEAR == min(YEAR, na.rm = TRUE), 1, started))


## Step 1: consider same starting year and university
# note: lags are computed within year of first year and institution; think about it as grouping by admission cycle.
# consequently, if the student switched schools, this lag is NA.
eg_sub %<>% arrange(mrun, anio_ing_carr_act, YEAR, codigo_unico) %>%
  group_by(mrun, anio_ing_carr_ori, nomb_inst) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    nomb_carrera_lag = lag(nomb_carrera),
    nomb_carrera_original_lag = lag(nomb_carrera_original),
    nomb_inst_lag = lag(nomb_inst),
    nomb_inst_original_lag = lag(nomb_inst_original),
    codigo_demre_lag = lag(codigo_demre),
    codigo_adicional_lag = lag(codigo_adicional),
    codigo_unico_lag = lag(codigo_unico),
    anio_ing_carr_ori_lag = lag(anio_ing_carr_ori),
    anio_ing_carr_act_lag = lag(anio_ing_carr_act)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

eg_sub %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  recoded =
    ifelse(is.na(codigo_unico_lag), 0,
      ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag, 0,
        ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag),
          ifelse(codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag, 0, ifelse(stringdist(nomb_carrera, nomb_carrera_lag) < 3, 1, 0)),
          ifelse(stringdist(nomb_carrera, nomb_carrera_lag) < 3, 1, 0)
        )
      )
    )
)

eg_sub %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  continued =
    ifelse(is.na(codigo_unico_lag), ifelse(started == 1, 0, NA),
      ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag | recoded == 1 | codigo_adicional == codigo_adicional_lag, 1,
        ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag), as.integer(codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag), 0)
      )
    )
) %>%
  arrange(mrun, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_adicional) %>%
  fill(continued, .direction = "up") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

eg_sub <- rbind(
  eg_sub %>% filter(!is.na(codigo_demre)) %>%
    arrange(mrun, codigo_demre, YEAR) %>%
    group_by(mrun, codigo_demre) %>% fill(continued, .direction = "up") %>% ungroup() %>% as.data.frame(),
  eg_sub %>% filter(is.na(codigo_demre)) %>% ungroup() %>% as.data.frame()
)

eg_sub %<>%
  arrange(mrun, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_unico) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    continued = if_else(YEAR - lag(YEAR) == 1 & !is.na(lag(YEAR)), 1, continued, missing = continued),
    returned = if_else(YEAR - lag(YEAR) > 1 & !is.na(lag(YEAR)), 1, 0, missing = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_demre) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    continued = if_else(YEAR - lag(YEAR) == 1 & !is.na(lag(YEAR)), 1, continued, missing = continued),
    returned = if_else(YEAR - lag(YEAR) > 1 & !is.na(lag(YEAR)), 1, returned, missing = returned)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_adicional) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    continued = if_else(YEAR - lag(YEAR) == 1 & !is.na(lag(YEAR)), 1, continued, missing = continued),
    returned = if_else(YEAR - lag(YEAR) > 1 & !is.na(lag(YEAR)), 1, returned, missing = returned)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    continued = ifelse(is.na(continued) & returned == 1, 0, continued),
    transitioned = ifelse(is.na(transitioned) & returned == 1, 0, transitioned),
    transferred = ifelse(is.na(transferred) & returned == 1, 0, transferred)
  )

eg_sub %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  transitioned = ifelse(is.na(transitioned) & continued == 1, 0, transitioned),
  transferred = ifelse(is.na(transferred) & continued == 1, 0, transferred),
  switched = ifelse(initiated + continued + transitioned + transferred + returned > 0, 0, switched)
)

saveRDS(eg_sub, "data/panel_enrollment_and_graduation.rds")
```

```{r}
pr <- readRDS("data/panel_enrollment_and_graduation.rds")

pr %<>%
  group_by(mrun) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(num_init = sum(initiated)) %>%
  ungroup()

pr <- rbind(
  pr %>%
    filter(num_init <= 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c("num_init")),
  pr %>%
    filter(num_init > 1) %>%
    group_by(mrun, codigo_unico) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(num_years_in_program = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(mrun, num_years_in_program, YEAR, codigo_unico) %>%
    group_by(mrun) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      switched = ifelse(row_number() > 1 & initiated == 1, 1, switched),
      initiated = ifelse(row_number() == 1, 1, 0)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c("num_years_in_program", "num_init"))
)

pr %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  started = ifelse(is.na(nomb_inst_lag), 1,
    ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag | codigo_adicional == codigo_adicional_lag, 0,
      ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag), as.integer(codigo_demre != codigo_demre_lag), ifelse(is.na(started), as.integer(YEAR == anio_ing_carr_act | YEAR == anio_ing_carr_ori), started))
    )
  ),
  continued = ifelse(is.na(nomb_inst_lag) | started == 1, 0,
    ifelse(nomb_inst != nomb_inst_lag, 0,
      ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag | codigo_adicional == codigo_adicional_lag, 1,
        ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori != anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 0,
          ifelse(anio_ing_carr_act != anio_ing_carr_act_lag, 0,
            ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag),
              as.integer(codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag),
              1
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  transitioned = ifelse(continued > 0, 0,
    ifelse(is.na(nomb_inst_lag), 0,
      ifelse(nomb_inst != nomb_inst_lag, 0,
        ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag | codigo_adicional == codigo_adicional_lag, 0,
          ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag),
            ifelse(codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag, 1,
              ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori == anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 1, transitioned)
            ),
            ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori == anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 1, transitioned)
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  transferred = ifelse(continued + transitioned > 0, 0,
    ifelse(is.na(nomb_inst_lag), 0,
      ifelse(nomb_inst != nomb_inst_lag, 0,
        ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag | codigo_adicional == codigo_adicional_lag, 0,
          ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag),
            ifelse(codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag, 0,
              ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori != anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 1, transferred)
            ),
            ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori != anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 1, transferred)
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  switched = ifelse(started == 1 & initiated == 0 & (continued + transitioned + transferred) == 0, 1,
    ifelse((continued + transitioned + transferred) > 0 | initiated == 1, 0,
      ifelse((continued + transitioned + transferred + initiated) == 0 & started == 1, 1, switched)
    )
  ),
  started = ifelse(switched + transferred + transitioned > 0, 1, started),
  graduated = ifelse(is.na(graduated), 0, graduated)
)

pr %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  codigo_demre =
    ifelse(nomb_inst == "UNIVERSIDAD ADOLFO IBAÑEZ" & grepl("INGENIERIA CIVIL", nomb_carrera),
      ifelse(region_sede == "Metropolitana", 42002, 42022), codigo_demre
    )
)

pr %<>%
  group_by(mrun) %>% # Create a unique student ID
  arrange(desc(YEAR)) %>% # Work backward from the most recent year
  dplyr::mutate(
    path_id = (cumsum(switched | transferred) - (switched | transferred))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ended = ifelse(YEAR == max(YEAR), 1, 0),
    dropout = ifelse(ended == 1 & graduated == 0, 1, 0),
    switching = ifelse(path_id > min(path_id), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(mrun, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_unico) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(path_id = min(path_id)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_demre) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(path_id = min(path_id)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_adicional) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(path_id = min(path_id)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mrun, path_id) %>%
  arrange(mrun, desc(YEAR)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    graduation_path = cummax(graduated),
    codigo_unico_start = last(codigo_unico[started == 1], default = NA),
    codigo_demre_start = last(codigo_demre[started == 1], default = NA)
  ) %>%
  fill(codigo_unico_start, .direction = "up") %>% # Propagate the starting program upward
  fill(codigo_demre_start, .direction = "up") %>% # Propagate the starting program upward
  dplyr::mutate(
    graduated = ifelse(graduation_path == 1 & codigo_unico == codigo_unico_start, 1, graduated)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

saveRDS(pr, "data/panel_enrollment_and_graduation.rds")
```

## Fix codigo_demre selecting the most common one for each codigo_unico
```{r}
pr %<>% dplyr::mutate(codigo_unico = case_when(
  codigo_unico %in% c("I10S7C16J1V1", "I10S7C16J2V2", "I10S7C16J3V1", "I10S7C16J4V2") ~ "I10S7C16J1V1",
  codigo_unico %in% c("I10S7C289J1V1", "I10S7C289J2V1", "I10S7C289J3V1", "I10S7C289J4V1") ~ "I10S7C289J1V1",
  TRUE ~ codigo_unico
))

pr1 <- pr %>%
  filter(!is.na(codigo_demre_original)) %>%
  group_by(codigo_unico_original, codigo_demre_original) %>%
  tally() %>%
  arrange(codigo_unico_original, -n) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(codigo_unico_original) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rid = row_number(),
    codigo_demre_fixed = first(codigo_demre_original)
  ) %>%
  filter(rid == 1)

fx <- merge(pr, pr1 %>% dplyr::select(codigo_unico_original, codigo_demre_fixed), by = "codigo_unico_original", all.x = TRUE)
fx %<>% dplyr::mutate(codigo_demre = codigo_demre_fixed) %>% dplyr::select(-codigo_demre_fixed)
fx %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  codigo_demre =
    ifelse(codigo_demre > 10000,
      codigo_demre,
      as.numeric(sub("(\\d{2})(\\d{2})", "\\10\\2", codigo_demre))
    )
)
```

After this step, codigo_unico_original uniquely identifies a codigo_demre, a nomb_sede and a nomb_carrera; it does not hold the other way aroudn.
```{r}
aux <- fx %>%
  filter(!is.na(codigo_demre)) %>%
  group_by(codigo_unico_original) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    nd = n_distinct(codigo_demre),
    ns = n_distinct(nomb_sede),
    nc = n_distinct(nomb_carrera)
  ) %>%
  arrange(-nd)
aux %>%
  filter(ns > 1 | nc > 1 | nd > 1) %>%
  nrow()
```

Fix nomb_sede, nomb_carrera based on codigo_demre

```{r}
aux <- fx %>%
  filter(!is.na(codigo_demre)) %>%
  group_by(codigo_demre) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    nu = n_distinct(codigo_unico_original),
    ns = n_distinct(nomb_sede),
    nc = n_distinct(nomb_carrera)
  ) %>%
  arrange(-nu)
cds <- aux %>%
  filter(ns > 1 | nc > 1) %>%
  distinct(codigo_demre) %>%
  pull(codigo_demre)
```

```{r}
aux <- fx %>%
  filter(codigo_demre %in% cds) %>%
  group_by(codigo_demre, nomb_carrera, nomb_sede) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(codigo_demre, -n) %>%
  group_by(codigo_demre) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rid = row_number(), nomb_carrera_fixed = first(nomb_carrera), nomb_sede_fixed = first(nomb_sede)) %>%
  filter(rid == 1)

fx <- merge(fx, aux %>% dplyr::select(codigo_demre, nomb_carrera_fixed, nomb_sede_fixed), by = "codigo_demre", all.x = TRUE)
fx %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  nomb_carrera = ifelse(!is.na(nomb_carrera_fixed), nomb_carrera_fixed, nomb_carrera),
  nomb_sede = ifelse(!is.na(nomb_sede_fixed), nomb_sede_fixed, nomb_sede)
) %>%
  dplyr::select(-nomb_carrera_fixed, -nomb_sede_fixed)
```

After this step, each codigo_unico uniquely identifies a codigo_demre, a nomb_sede and a nomb_carrera; it does not hold the other way around. Also, a codigo_demre uniquely identifies a nomb_sede and nomb_carrera. It does not hold the other way around (e.g., vespertino programs)

```{r}
  group_by(nomb_sede, nomb_inst, nomb_carrera) %>%
  arrange(-n) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rid = row_number(), ncd = n_distinct(codigo_demre)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(nomb_carrera_fixed = ifelse(rid == 2 & floor(codigo_demre / 1000) %in% c(16, 26, 49, 53, 46),
    paste(nomb_carrera, "VESPERTINO", sep = " "), nomb_carrera
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(nomb_carrera != nomb_carrera_fixed) %>%
  dplyr::select(codigo_demre, nomb_carrera_fixed)

fx <- merge(fx, aux, by = "codigo_demre", all.x = TRUE)

fx %<>% dplyr::mutate(nomb_carrera = ifelse(!is.na(nomb_carrera_fixed), nomb_carrera_fixed, nomb_carrera)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-nomb_carrera_fixed)
```

```{r}
aux <- fx %>%
  filter(!is.na(codigo_demre)) %>%
  group_by(nomb_sede, nomb_inst, nomb_carrera, codigo_demre) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(nomb_sede, nomb_inst, nomb_carrera) %>%
  arrange(-n) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rid = row_number(), ncd = n_distinct(codigo_demre), codigo_demre_fixed = first(codigo_demre)) %>%
  filter(ncd > 1) %>%
  arrange(nomb_sede, nomb_inst, nomb_carrera, -n) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(codigo_demre != codigo_demre_fixed) %>%
  dplyr::select(codigo_demre, codigo_demre_fixed)
# %>%
#   filter(rid == 1)

fx <- merge(fx, aux, by = "codigo_demre", all.x = TRUE)
fx %<>% dplyr::mutate(codigo_demre = ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre_fixed), codigo_demre_fixed, codigo_demre)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-codigo_demre_fixed) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    nomb_carrera = ifelse(codigo_unico_original == "I78S7C132J2V1", "TECNICO SUPERIOR EN TURISMO ENOLOGICO",
      ifelse(codigo_unico_original %in% c("I78S7C104J1V2", "I78S7C104J1V1", "I78S7C104J2V1", "I78S7C104J2V2"), "TECNICO SUPERIOR VINIFICACION Y ENOLOGIA",
        ifelse(codigo_unico_original == "I94S1C44J1V1", "DISEÑO PRODUCTO",
          ifelse(codigo_unico_original == "I94S1C25J1V1", "TRABAJO SOCIAL", nomb_carrera)
        )
      )
    ),
    codigo_demre = ifelse(codigo_unico_original == "I78S7C132J2V1", NA,
      ifelse(codigo_unico_original %in% c("I78S7C104J1V2", "I78S7C104J1V1", "I78S7C104J2V1", "I78S7C104J2V2"), 34702,
        ifelse(codigo_unico_original == "I94S1C44J1V1", 37002,
          ifelse(codigo_unico_original == "I94S1C25J1V1", 37004, codigo_demre)
        )
      )
    )
  )
```

###  Missings cases: group by nomb_carrera and nomb_inst and nomb_sede, and select most common one
```{r}
aux <- fx %>%
  filter(!is.na(codigo_demre)) %>%
  group_by(codigo_unico_original, codigo_demre, nomb_inst, nomb_carrera, nomb_sede, comuna_sede) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(nomb_inst, nomb_carrera, nomb_sede, codigo_demre, -n) %>%
  group_by(nomb_inst, nomb_carrera, nomb_sede, codigo_demre) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rid = row_number(), codigo_unico_fixed = first(codigo_unico_original), comuna_sede_fixed = first(comuna_sede)) %>%
  ungroup()


fx2 <- merge(fx %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::mutate(rid = row_number()),
  aux %>% dplyr::select(codigo_unico_original, codigo_unico_fixed, comuna_sede_fixed),
  by = "codigo_unico_original", all.x = TRUE
)
fx2 %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  codigo_unico = ifelse(!is.na(codigo_unico_fixed), codigo_unico_fixed, codigo_unico_original),
  comuna_sede = ifelse(!is.na(comuna_sede_fixed), comuna_sede_fixed, comuna_sede)
) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c("codigo_unico_fixed", "comuna_sede_fixed"))

fx2 %<>% group_by(rid) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rid1 = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(rid1 == 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(-rid1)
```

## Final fixes
```{r}
fx4 <- readRDS("data/panel_enrollment_and_graduation.rds")

aux <- fx4 %>%
  group_by(codigo_unico, codigo_demre, nomb_inst, nomb_carrera, nomb_sede) %>%
  tally() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(nomb_inst, nomb_carrera, nomb_sede, -n) %>%
  group_by(nomb_inst, nomb_carrera, nomb_sede) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    nd = n_distinct(codigo_demre), rid = row_number(),
    codigo_unico_fixed = first(codigo_unico),
    codigo_demre_fixed = first(codigo_demre)
  ) %>%
  filter(rid == 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c("nd", "rid"))

fx5 <- merge(fx4, aux, by = c("nomb_inst", "nomb_carrera", "nomb_sede"), all.x = TRUE)

fx5 %<>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    codigo_demre = ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre_fixed), codigo_demre_fixed, codigo_demre),
    codigo_unico = ifelse(!is.na(codigo_unico_fixed), codigo_unico_fixed, codigo_unico)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c("codigo_demre_fixed", "codigo_unico_fixed"))

fx5 %<>% dplyr::mutate(codigo_demre = case_when(
  nomb_inst == "UNIVERSIDAD SANTO TOMAS" & nomb_carrera == "INGENIERIA CIVIL INDUSTRIAL" & nomb_sede == "SEDE CONCEPCION" ~ 55119,
  nomb_inst == "UNIVERSIDAD GABRIELA MISTRAL" & nomb_carrera == "INGENIERIA CIVIL INFORMATICA" & nomb_sede == "SEDE CASTRO" ~ 54121,
  nomb_inst == "UNIVERSIDAD TECNOLOGICA METROPOLITANA" & nomb_carrera == "PSICOLOGIA" & nomb_sede == "SEDE CENTRAL" ~ 21053,
  TRUE ~ codigo_demre
))
```

### Unify nomb_carrea for business
```{r}

  (grepl("CONTADOR", nomb_carrera) |
    grepl("CONTABILIDAD Y AUDITORIA", nomb_carrera) |
    grepl("CONTABILIDAD GENERAL", nomb_carrera)) &
    grepl("VESP", nomb_carrera) ~ "CONTADOR AUDITOR VESPERTINO",
  (grepl("CONTADOR", nomb_carrera) |
    grepl("CONTABILIDAD Y AUDITORIA", nomb_carrera) |
    grepl("CONTABILIDAD GENERAL", nomb_carrera)) &
    !grepl("VESP", nomb_carrera) ~ "CONTADOR AUDITOR",
  grepl("ADMINISTRACION Y NEGOCIOS", nomb_carrera) ~ "ADMINISTRACION EMPRESAS",
  grepl("ANALISTA SISTEMAS", nomb_carrera) |
    grepl("ANALISIS SISTEMAS", nomb_carrera) ~ "ANALISIS SISTEMAS",
  TRUE ~ nomb_carrera
))
```

```{r}
    codigo_demre == 14097 ~ 14039,
    codigo_demre == 41202 ~ 41036,
    codigo_demre == 17844 ~ 17011,
    codigo_demre == 16090 ~ 16081,
    codigo_demre == 16040 ~ 16079,
    codigo_demre == 22075 ~ 22069,
    codigo_demre == 15453 ~ 15032,
    codigo_unico == "I88S2C494J1V1" ~ 15032,
    TRUE ~ codigo_demre
  )
)
```

```{r}
  dplyr::mutate(codigo_aux = cur_group_id()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
```

```{r}
  anio_ing_carr_ori =
    case_when(
      year >= anio_ing_carr_ori ~ anio_ing_carr_ori,
      year < anio_ing_carr_ori ~ year,
      TRUE ~ anio_ing_carr_ori
    ),
  anio_ing_carr_act =
    case_when(
      year >= anio_ing_carr_ori ~ anio_ing_carr_act,
      year < anio_ing_carr_ori ~ year,
      TRUE ~ anio_ing_carr_act
    ),
)

d %<>% group_by(mrun, codigo_aux) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    anio_ing_carr_ori = ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori > min(anio_ing_carr_ori), min(anio_ing_carr_ori), anio_ing_carr_ori),
    anio_ing_carr_act = ifelse(anio_ing_carr_act > min(anio_ing_carr_act), min(anio_ing_carr_act), anio_ing_carr_act)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  arrange(mrun, anio_ing_carr_ori, year)
```

```{r}
  codigo_aux_lead = shift(codigo_aux, type = "lead"),
```

```{r}
d <- as.data.frame(dt)
rm(dt)
gc(reset = TRUE)

d %<>%
  rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(contained = if_else(grepl(nomb_carrera, nomb_carrera_lag) |
    grepl(nomb_carrera_lag, nomb_carrera) |
    all(str_split(nomb_carrera_lag, " ")[[1]] %in% str_split(nomb_carrera, " ")[[1]]) |
    all(str_split(nomb_carrera, " ")[[1]] %in% str_split(nomb_carrera_lag, " ")[[1]]), 1, 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

d %<>% dplyr::mutate(
  continued = case_when(
    is.na(year_prev) ~ continued,
    year > year_prev + 1 ~ continued,
    nomb_carrera == nomb_carrera_lag |
      codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag |
      codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag |
      contained ~ 1,
    grepl("INGENIERIA CIVIL", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("INGENIERIA CIVIL", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("INGENIERIA Y CIENCIAS", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("INGENIERIA CIVIL", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("INGENIERIA Y CIENCIAS", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("GEO", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("INGENIERIA Y CIENCIAS", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("FISICA Y ASTRONOMIA", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("COMERCIAL", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("COMERCIAL", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("EDUCACION", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("EDUCACION", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("FISICA", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("FISICA", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("MECANICA Y MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("MECANICA", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("MECANICA Y MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("MECANICA Y MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera) & grepl("MECANICA", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    grepl("MECANICA Y MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera) & grepl("MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    grepl("TRADUCCION", nomb_carrera) & grepl("INGLES", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    grepl("TRADUCCION", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("INGLES", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("TEATRO", nomb_carrera) & grepl("ACTUACION", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    grepl("TEATRO", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("ACTUACION", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("CONSTRUCCION", nomb_carrera) & grepl("CONSTRUCCION", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ continued
  ),
  resumed = case_when(
    is.na(year_prev) ~ resumed,
    year == year_prev + 1 ~ resumed,
    nomb_carrera == nomb_carrera_lag |
      codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag |
      codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag |
      contained ~ 1,
    grepl("INGENIERIA CIVIL", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("INGENIERIA CIVIL", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("INGENIERIA Y CIENCIAS", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("INGENIERIA CIVIL", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("INGENIERIA Y CIENCIAS", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("GEO", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("INGENIERIA Y CIENCIAS", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("FISICA Y ASTRONOMIA", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("COMERCIAL", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("COMERCIAL", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("EDUCACION", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("EDUCACION", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("ACUICULTURA", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("ACUICULTURA", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("FISICA", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("FISICA", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("MECANICA Y MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("MECANICA", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("MECANICA Y MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("MECANICA Y MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera) & grepl("MECANICA", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    grepl("MECANICA Y MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera) & grepl("MECATRONICA", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    grepl("TRADUCCION", nomb_carrera) & grepl("INGLES", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    grepl("TRADUCCION", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("INGLES", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("TEATRO", nomb_carrera) & grepl("ACTUACION", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    grepl("TEATRO", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("ACTUACION", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("CONSTRUCCION", nomb_carrera) & grepl("CONSTRUCCION", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ resumed
  ),
  progressed = case_when(
    is.na(year_prev) ~ 0,
    continued + resumed > 0 ~ 0,
    grepl("BACHILL", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("BACHILL", nomb_carrera) ~ 0,
    grepl("BACHILL", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("COLLEGE", nomb_carrera) ~ 0,
    grepl("COLLEGE", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("BACHILL", nomb_carrera) ~ 0,
    grepl("COLLEGE", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("COLLEGE", nomb_carrera) ~ 0,
    grepl("SALUD", nomb_carrera_lag) &
      !(grepl("MEDICINA", nomb_carrera) | grepl("ENFERMERIA", nomb_carrera) |
        grepl("ODONTOLOGIA", nomb_carrera) | grepl("NUTRICION", nomb_carrera) |
        grepl("VETERINARIA", nomb_carrera) | grepl("MEDICA", nomb_carrera) |
        grepl("FARMACIA", nomb_carrera) | grepl("TERAPIA", nomb_carrera) |
        grepl("FONOAUDIOLOGIA", nomb_carrera) | grepl("PSICOLOGIA", nomb_carrera) |
        grepl("QUIMICA", nomb_carrera) | grepl("PSICOLOGIA", nomb_carrera) |
        grepl("OBSTETRICIA", nomb_carrera) | grepl("KINESIOLOGIA", nomb_carrera)) ~ 0,
    grepl("BACHILL", nomb_carrera_lag) | grepl("COLLEGE", nomb_carrera_lag) ~ 1,
    grepl("LICENCIATURA CIENCIAS SOCIALES", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("DERECHO", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    grepl("LICENCIATURA CIENCIAS SOCIALES", nomb_carrera_lag) & grepl("COMERCIAL", nomb_carrera) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ),
  transitioned = case_when(
    is.na(year_prev) ~ 0,
    continued + resumed + progressed > 0 ~ 0,
    anio_ing_carr_act == anio_ing_carr_act_lag ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ),
  transferred = case_when(
    is.na(year_prev) ~ 0,
    continued + resumed + progressed + transitioned > 0 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )
)
```

pr <- readRDS('data/panel_enrollment_and_graduation.rds')

pr %<>% 
  group_by(mrun) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(num_init = sum(initiated)) %>%
  ungroup 

pr <- rbind(pr %>% 
              filter(num_init <= 1) %>% 
              dplyr::select(-c("num_init")), 
            pr %>% 
              filter(num_init > 1) %>% 
              group_by(mrun, codigo_unico) %>% 
              dplyr::mutate(num_years_in_program = n()) %>%
              ungroup %>%
              dplyr::arrange(mrun, num_years_in_program, YEAR, codigo_unico) %>% 
              group_by(mrun) %>%
              dplyr::mutate(switched = ifelse(row_number() > 1 & initiated == 1, 1, switched),
                            initiated = ifelse(row_number() == 1, 1, 0) ) %>% 
              dplyr::select(-c("num_years_in_program","num_init"))
            )

pr %<>% dplyr::mutate(started = ifelse(is.na(nomb_inst_lag), 1, 
                                       ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag | codigo_adicional == codigo_adicional_lag, 0, 
                                              ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag), as.integer(codigo_demre != codigo_demre_lag) , ifelse(is.na(started), as.integer(YEAR == anio_ing_carr_act | YEAR == anio_ing_carr_ori), started)
                                                     ) 
                                              ) 
                                       ), 
                      continued = ifelse(is.na(nomb_inst_lag) | started == 1, 0, 
                                         ifelse(nomb_inst != nomb_inst_lag, 0, 
                                                ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag | codigo_adicional == codigo_adicional_lag, 1,
                                                        ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori != anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 0, 
                                                               ifelse(anio_ing_carr_act != anio_ing_carr_act_lag, 0, 
                                                                      ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag), 
                                                                            as.integer(codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag), 
                                                                            1) 
                                                                    )
                                                              )
                                                       ) 
                                                )
                                         ), 
                      transitioned = ifelse(continued > 0, 0, 
                                            ifelse(is.na(nomb_inst_lag), 0, 
                                                   ifelse(nomb_inst != nomb_inst_lag, 0, 
                                                          ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag | codigo_adicional == codigo_adicional_lag, 0,
                                                                 ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag), 
                                                                        ifelse(codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag, 1, 
                                                                               ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori == anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 1, transitioned) 
                                                                               ),
                                                                        ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori == anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 1, transitioned)
                                                                        ) 
                                                                 ) 
                                                          )
                                                   )
                                         ),
                      transferred = ifelse(continued + transitioned > 0, 0, 
                                            ifelse(is.na(nomb_inst_lag), 0, 
                                                   ifelse(nomb_inst != nomb_inst_lag, 0, 
                                                          ifelse(codigo_unico == codigo_unico_lag | codigo_adicional == codigo_adicional_lag, 0,
                                                                 ifelse(!is.na(codigo_demre) & !is.na(codigo_demre_lag), 
                                                                        ifelse(codigo_demre == codigo_demre_lag, 0, 
                                                                               ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori != anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 1, transferred) 
                                                                               ),
                                                                        ifelse(anio_ing_carr_ori != anio_ing_carr_ori_lag, 1, transferred)
                                                                        ) 
                                                                 ) 
                                                          )
                                                   )
                                         ),                     
                      switched = ifelse(started == 1 & initiated == 0 & (continued + transitioned + transferred) == 0, 1, 
                                        ifelse((continued + transitioned + transferred) > 0 | initiated == 1, 0, 
                                               ifelse((continued + transitioned + transferred + initiated) == 0 & started == 1 , 1, switched)) ), 
                      started = ifelse(switched + transferred + transitioned > 0, 1, started), 
                      graduated = ifelse(is.na(graduated), 0, graduated)
                      )

  group_by(mrun) %>% # Create a unique student ID
  arrange(desc(YEAR)) %>% # Work backward from the most recent year
  dplyr::mutate(
    path_id = (cumsum(switched | transferred) - (switched | transferred))
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    ended = ifelse(YEAR == max(YEAR), 1, 0),
    dropout = ifelse(ended == 1 & graduated == 0, 1, 0),
    switching = ifelse(path_id > min(path_id), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(mrun, YEAR) %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_unico) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(path_id = min(path_id)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_demre) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(path_id = min(path_id)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mrun, codigo_adicional) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(path_id = min(path_id)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(mrun, path_id) %>%
  arrange(mrun, desc(YEAR)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(  
    graduation_path = cummax(graduated),
    codigo_unico_start = last(codigo_unico[started == 1], default = NA), 
    codigo_demre_start = last(codigo_demre[started == 1], default = NA)
    ) %>%
  fill(codigo_unico_start, .direction = "up") %>% # Propagate the starting program upward
  fill(codigo_demre_start, .direction = "up") %>% # Propagate the starting program upward
  dplyr::mutate(
    graduated = ifelse( graduation_path == 1 & codigo_unico == codigo_unico_start, 1, graduated)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
